# scanpy-scrna-seq

## What it does

Single-cell RNA-seq analysis with Scanpy — preprocessing, clustering, visualization and standard
downstream steps.

## When to use / when not

Use when the task is scRNA-seq analysis in Python with Scanpy.

This is a third-party skill from SciAgent-Skills, not maintained in this repository.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add jaechang-hits/SciAgent-Skills@scanpy-scrna-seq
```

## Install in Claude Science

**Skills → Add skill → Import from GitHub**, then paste:

```
https://github.com/HelmholtzAI-Consultants-Munich/helmholtz-agent-skills
```

That installs the curated `scanpy` plugin, not the whole SciAgent-Skills repository.
[Walkthrough](../claude-science.md).
